infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Emberly Maintenance uses the camera to photograph work orders and property-map annotations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Emberly Maintenance attaches photos from your library to property-map annotations.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Emberly Maintenance uses the microphone so you can dictate work-order notes instead of typing them.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Emberly Maintenance transcribes your dictated notes on this device. The audio is not sent to Apple or to Emberly.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Emberly Maintenance uses Face ID to protect the sign-in credentials stored on this device.
